requirements.title: Health endpoint returns status and tool count
requirements.text: System returns a JSON response with status 'ok' and the tools count when a GET request is sent to /api/health.

requirements.title: List tools endpoint returns categorized tools
requirements.text: System returns a JSON response with count, categories, and tools when a GET request is sent to /api/tools.

requirements.title: Run calculator with invalid JSON returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error message 'invalid JSON' when a POST request with malformed body is sent to /api/calc.

requirements.title: Run calculator with unknown calculator name returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error message including 'unknown calculator' and list of available calculators when a POST request with an unrecognized 'calculator' field is sent to /api/calc.

requirements.title: Run calculator with invalid parameters returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with the sanitization error message when sanitizing parameters fails in a POST request to /api/calc.

requirements.title: Run calculator with domain errors returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error message prefixed 'invalid inputs:' when the calculator function raises ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, KeyError, or TypeError.

requirements.title: Run calculator with unexpected error returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error message 'calculation failed' when the calculator function raises an unexpected exception.

requirements.title: Payload too large returns 413
requirements.text: System returns a 413 JSON response with error 'payload too large' when a POST request to an /api endpoint has a body larger than 16 KB.

requirements.title: Rate limit exceeded returns 429
requirements.text: System returns a 429 JSON response with error 'rate limit exceeded, slow down' when more than 90 requests per 10 seconds are sent from the same client IP to the /api path.
requirements.quote: send, 429, b'{"error":"rate limit exceeded, slow down"}'

requirements.title: Security headers are added to every HTTP response
requirements.text: System adds a predefined set of HTTP security headers (including x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy, strict-transport-security, cross-origin-opener-policy, and content-security-policy) to every HTTP response.

requirements.title: Query parameter 'code' validation in api_nav
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'invalid scheme code' when the 'code' query parameter in a GET request to /api/nav is not all digits or is longer than 9 characters.

requirements.title: Query parameter 'q' validation in api_nav
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'query must be 1–80 characters' when the 'q' query parameter in a GET request to /api/nav is empty or longer than 80 characters.
requirements.quote: return JSONResponse({"error": "query must be 1–80 characters"}, status_code=400)

requirements.title: Invalid currency code in api_fx returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'invalid currency code' when the 'base' or 'symbols' query parameters in a GET request to /api/fx do not match the currency code pattern.

requirements.title: Invalid symbol in api_quote returns 400
requirements.text: System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'invalid symbol' when the 'symbol' query parameter in a GET request to /api/quote does not match the symbol regex pattern.

requirements.title: Sharpe ratio returns error when standard deviation is zero
requirements.text: System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Standard deviation cannot be zero' when the sharpe_ratio function is called with a portfolio_std_dev of 0.

requirements.title: Treynor ratio returns error when beta is zero
requirements.text: System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Beta cannot be zero' when the treynor_ratio function is called with a beta of 0.

requirements.title: Information ratio returns error when tracking error is zero
requirements.text: System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Tracking error cannot be zero' when the information_ratio function is called with a tracking_error of 0.

requirements.title: Sortino ratio returns error when downside deviation is zero
requirements.text: System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Downside deviation cannot be zero' when the sortino_ratio function is called with a downside_deviation of 0.

requirements.title: Portfolio expected return returns error on length mismatch
requirements.text: System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Weights and returns must have same length' when the portfolio_expected_return function is called with weights and returns lists of different lengths.
requirements.quote: return {"error": "Weights and returns must have same length"}

requirements.title: Portfolio risk returns error on dimensions mismatch
requirements.text: System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Dimensions mismatch' when the portfolio_risk function is called with weights, std_devs, and correlations lists of mismatched sizes.

requirements.title: Parameter sanitization rejects invalid params object
requirements.text: System raises ValueError('invalid parameters') when _sanitize_params receives a non-dict argument or a dict with more than 30 keys.

requirements.title: Parameter sanitization rejects non-finite numbers
requirements.text: System raises ValueError when a parameter value is a float or int with non-finite value (NaN, Inf, -Inf).
requirements.quote: raise ValueError(f"'{k}' must be a finite number")

requirements.title: Parameter sanitization rejects out of range numbers
requirements.text: System raises ValueError when a parameter value has an absolute value greater than 1e13.
requirements.quote: raise ValueError(f"'{k}' is out of range")

requirements.title: Parameter sanitization rejects values exceeding per-parameter caps
requirements.text: System raises ValueError when a parameter value exceeds its defined cap (e.g., years > 120, months > 2400) in PARAM_CAPS.

requirements.title: Parameter sanitization rejects long parameter names and string values
requirements.text: System raises ValueError('invalid parameter name') when a parameter key is longer than 40 characters, and raises ValueError when a string parameter value is longer than 40 characters.

requirements.title: Server runs on port from PORT env var
requirements.text: System (main function) starts the web server on the port specified by the PORT environment variable, defaulting to 7860.
